issue.title: 90-column Agents tab collapses the detail/deck column to 0-19 cells
issue.description:
At 90 columns the Agents tab gives the agent list nearly the whole width and squeezes the detail column (header + deck panel) to 0-19 cells. The committed 90x40 monitor goldens show it: `agents_monitor_state_running_90x40` has a ~19-cell deck, `agents_monitor_state_host_completed_90x40` ~3 cells, and `failed_diagnostics`/`needs_attention` render the Main view at width 0 (no section anchors are ever published, so a Main section cannot be scrolled to or matched as text). The width depends on how wide the agent names are, so it varies per fixture.

Found while migrating `test_monitor_state_detail_png_snapshots`: the plan asked for MONITOR/Result:/Next:/Evidence: assertions at both widths, but at 90 columns the deck is unusable (words wrap mid-token, or the view has width 0), so those assertions are gated to `width >= 120`.

Pre-existing: the pre-deck 90x40 golden shows the same ~9-cell strip. Not caused by the deck cutover.

task_type_fields.impact: At 90 columns the deck (Main/Files/Tools) and header are unreadable for agents with long names; MainDeckView gets width 0 so section navigation cannot work.
task_type_fields.location: Agents tab list/detail column layout (src/sase/ace/tui/styles.tcss, agent list vs #agent-detail-panel widths)
task_type_fields.repro: Run tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_family_panel_monitor.py::test_monitor_state_detail_png_snapshots[failed_diagnostics-overrides2-90-40] and inspect agents_monitor_state_failed_diagnostics_90x40.png, or open sase tui at 90x40 with an agent named visual-monitor-failed_diagnostics--mon.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during the sase-1ap.4 landing, from phase sase-1ap.4.2 note #1. At 90x32, test_agents_bead_created_by_agent_narrow_png_snapshot cannot keep phase bead sase-1e: the detail column narrows to about 14 cells and the split Context card drops to about 6 cells, so Beads: and CREATED wrap mid-token and the SVG sentinels never match. The committed test passes phase_bead_id=None so the CREATED pill stays contiguous in agents_bead_created_by_agent_90x32.png. The 120x40 golden still shows the phase-bead card, the CREATED and CLOSED pills, the why: lines, and the assigned row. At 752edf9fc, just test-visual on the created wide, created narrow, and closed narrow nodes passed all three. This is the same 90-column list-versus-detail collapse, with the phase-bead fixture as another case where the deck is unreadable.
